answer: Every identity wears a tracer. Each epoch it folds a private canary into agent inputs: a faint ripple in a number field, a copper tag, an onyx glyph. The canary comes from that key's secret, so none is shared; returned work is checked against it. A farm running 1000 keys off one model, or copying a neighbour, ships the wrong tracer: another key's copper tag and onyx. One mismatch voids the work; all keys sharing a canary collapse into one weight. To earn, a farmer must give each identity its own stream and right marker every epoch. Copies pay nothing: the attack buys compute for nothing.
